senses.definition: n.pr.m. king of Assyria (proposes -אסרד, = Assyrian Šulman-ašaridu, ‘(God) Šulman is chief,’ SchrZK ii (1885), 197 ff. Muss-ArnoltJBL xi (1892), 79);—2 K 17:3 = 18:9; Σαλ(α)μανασ(σ)αρ, 𝔙 Salmanasar. This was שׁ׳ V, b.c. 727–722, SayHast DB s. v. JohnsEncy. Bib. s. v..
